description: Build a link to slime-studio.co.uk that opens the shopper's basket pre-filled with these slimes (and an optional promo code), with the subtotal and estimated standard delivery. Give the link to the shopper: they review the basket and pay on Stripe Checkout. Creates no order and needs no personal data. UK delivery only.

items.description: The slimes to put in the basket, 1 to 20 lines; repeated slugs are combined

qty.description: Number of pots, 1 to 10; more is capped at 10

promo_code.description: Optional promo code to pre-fill; checkout validates it

source.description: Optional short tag for your app or agent, lowercase letters, digits, '.', '_' or '-' (e.g. 'claude'). Defaults to 'mcp'.

name: create_basket_link

basket_url.description: Give this link to the shopper; it opens their basket on slime-studio.co.uk

estimated_standard_shipping_gbp.description: Standard UK delivery for this basket in pounds sterling (GBP), e.g. 8.99

estimated_standard_shipping_pence.description: Standard UK delivery for this basket in pence (GBP minor units), e.g. 899

notes.description: Adjustments made to the request, if any

subtotal_gbp.description: Slimes subtotal in pounds sterling (GBP), e.g. 8.99

subtotal_pence.description: Slimes subtotal in pence (GBP minor units), e.g. 899

title: Create basket link
